data_objects.name: solar_magnetic_region_series
data_objects.meaning: Time series of summarized solar magnetic-region measurements, including flux, field-gradient, electric-current, helicity, energy, shear, and area metrics.
data_objects.notes: Most measurement names are abbreviated and their exact definitions and units are not supplied in train.csv.

variables.name: TRUE_TIME
variables.meaning: Absolute observation timestamp encoded with a TAI suffix.

variables.name: TIME
variables.meaning: Elapsed time coordinate aligned with TRUE_TIME.

variables.name: USFLUX
variables.meaning: Unsigned magnetic-flux summary metric labeled USFLUX.

variables.name: MEANGAM
variables.meaning: Mean magnetic-field inclination metric labeled MEANGAM.

variables.name: MEANGBT
variables.meaning: Mean gradient metric for the total magnetic field.

variables.name: MEANGBZ
variables.meaning: Mean gradient metric for the vertical magnetic-field component.

variables.name: MEANGBH
variables.meaning: Mean gradient metric for the horizontal magnetic-field component.

variables.name: SHRGT45
variables.meaning: Share of the measured region associated with shear above the threshold encoded in the field name.

variables.name: AREA_ACR
variables.meaning: Area metric for the active measured region.

structure.description: Each row represents one successive observation time; TRUE_TIME is the absolute temporal key and TIME is its elapsed-hours coordinate.
All magnetic and area fields are summaries for the same observed region at the row timestamp.

uncertainties: The observed solar region, instrument, spatial mask, and measurement procedures are not identified.
The precise expansions, formulas, sign conventions, and physical units of the abbreviated metrics are not established by train.csv.
The reference origin of TIME is not supplied.
annotation_notes: Opaque parameters retain their source labels and null units rather than receiving unsupported formula or unit definitions.
